audit.why: Lane is genuinely hard early (spear poke, point-click stun all-in), TF scales onto the map post-6 and Pantheon's single-target kit falls off late. The 54.59% TF win rate despite a Pantheon-favoured chart is the classic lane-loser-wins-game shape — not a chart defect to flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart had all seven rows 'Pantheon' while content and packet give Skill on Level 3, Levels 4-5 and 2+ items.
audit.why: Packet levelChart and content win[] agree: [Pantheon, Pantheon, Skill, Skill, Pantheon, Pantheon, Skill]. Full disagreed on rows 3, 4 and 7.
audit.corrected: phases[2/3/6].side moved to Skill; whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content called Pantheon's W 'Aegis Assault stun jump' (W is Shield Vault; Aegis Assault is E), and claimed his passive 'blocks your autos and card procs' — his current passive Mortal Will empowers spells; nothing in his kit passively blocks autos (frontal block is the E channel). The page also never stated the decisive interactions: yellow card interrupts the Aegis Assault channel, E blocks frontal burst, W is an auto-reset tell.
audit.why: Riot kit text: W 'dashes to a target, damaging and stunning', E 'sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front' (shield/untargetable/channel flags), P 'every few spells or attacks, next spell is empowered'. missingInteractions lists channel-interruptible vs Pick a Card, shield-absorbs-burst, autoreset tell.
audit.corrected: Names fixed everywhere, passive-block claims replaced with verified spear/Mortal Will facts, E-channel interactions written into cooldowns and don'ts.

audit.why: W 13/12/11/10/9, E 22-18, Q 11-8 are the timers the lane runs on.
Common mistakes are behavioural, no elo tiers.

edits.before: Pantheon wins by landing Shield Vault (Stun), denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Pantheon wins by landing Shield Vault's stun, following with an empowered Comet Spear, and eating your burst on Aegis Assault.

edits.before: Full kit: stacked-deck autos plus card cycling is a real short trade — but your game is the clock, not the lane.
edits.after: Full kit: Wild Cards farm from range stalls him — even mechanics, and your game is the clock, not the lane.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q the wave, lock cards on cooldown, and watch side lanes like they're your KDA.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — even if you respect the stun: Q the wave, hold yellow, and watch the side lanes.

edits.before: Late TF is a coin with two good sides: split the side lane R-safe, or hold Destiny as the pick-and-collapse button.
edits.after: Late is a wash: his single-target dive falls off — split R-safe or hold Destiny as the pick-and-collapse button.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Check it before every step-up. - W gold card is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — a 13s point-and-click stun at rank 1, 9s max: respect the all-in whenever it's up. - Aegis Assault (E) is 22s and blocks from the front — your yellow card interrupts the channel outright.

edits.before: Lock gold off-screen, walk up once, card-auto-Q, and leave — one stun-chunk per cycle is all the lane asks of you.
edits.after: Wild Cards outranges his 575 spear by miles — chip from beyond it and he cannot answer without burning Shield Vault.

edits.before: Cycling cards inside his engage range for stacked-deck greed — TF dies in exactly one mistimed auto-walk per game; don't pre-book it.
edits.after: Aegis Assault blocks everything from the front for its whole channel — burst into it vanishes; make him spend the E before your gold card goes.

edits.before: Pantheon's passive blocks your basic-attack card procs and his Comet Spear out-ranges any trade you can make at level 1.
edits.after: Pantheon's 575-range Comet Spear on an 11s cooldown chunks you on every last hit — no level-1 trade comes back even.

edits.before: Pantheon spikes with W Aegis Assault's stun jump plus empowered Q Comet Spear; his short-range all-in forces you to hold Blue Card distance and never step for a greedy last hit.
edits.after: Pantheon spikes with Shield Vault's (W) stun dash plus empowered Comet Spear; the 600-range all-in forces you to hold max-card distance and never step up for a greedy last hit.

edits.before: L1-2 Pantheon's passive blocks your autos and card procs while his Q Comet Spear chunks you on every step; you have no way to trade back, so soak XP at max range and never walk into spear range for a last hit. He wins any level-1 or level-2 exchange outright.
edits.after: L1-2 Pantheon's Comet Spear chunks you on every step and Mortal Will empowers a spear every few casts; you have no way to trade back, so soak XP at max range and never walk into his 575 spear range for a last hit. He wins any level-1 or level-2 exchange outright.

edits.before: L3-6 his W Aegis Assault stun into empowered Comet Spear is a full combo that kills a low Twisted Fate; farm with Wild Cards from the back line and only use Pick a Card to secure minions, saving Yellow Card for when he actually commits his jump. Do not contest the wave up close.
edits.after: L3-6 his Shield Vault stun into empowered Comet Spear is a full combo that kills a low Twisted Fate; farm with Wild Cards from the back line and only use Pick a Card to secure minions, saving Yellow Card for when he actually commits the dash. Do not contest the wave up close.

edits.before: Hold Yellow Card to peel his W Aegis Assault jump
edits.after: Hold Yellow Card to peel his Shield Vault (W) dash

edits.before: Deny your cannon minions behind his passive block
edits.after: Zone you off cannon minions with empowered spear poke

notes: Fabricated/swapped names killed: W is Shield Vault, E is Aegis Assault — content had them merged into 'W Aegis Assault stun jump' in three places, and the passive-blocks-autos claim (old pre-rework passive) was replaced with verified Mortal Will/Comet Spear facts. Chart: full-layer rows 3, 4 and 7 moved to Skill to agree with content and packet (win[N] already held Skill, so no content pairs — adding them would be no-op rejections). The packet defect flagging the chart vs the 54.59% TF win rate was judged NOT a chart error: TF loses lane stages and wins games on the map; recorded here rather than flipped. phases[].rating left untouched (semantics not derivable).
